components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;grid-template:repeat(3,44px)/repeat(3,44px);width:132px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fill);color:var(--ink)}.ds-nav button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--fill-strong)}.ds-nav button:not(:disabled):active{background:var(--blue-wash)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px}.ds-nav button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}.ds-nav svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-forward{grid-area:1/2}.ds-left{grid-area:2/1}.ds-home{grid-area:2/2;color:var(--blue)!important}.ds-right{grid-area:2/3}.ds-back{grid-area:3/2}.ds-left svg{rotate:-90deg}.ds-right svg{rotate:90deg}.ds-back svg{rotate:180deg}

narrative.overview: Open view is the user-selected direction. Cool white or dark slate panels sit over a full-screen city model. Compact controls leave the skyline visible, and building actions appear after selection.
keyCharacteristics: System UI type and quiet separators.
Solid panels with consistent corners and shared shadows.
Grouped camera controls with adjacent live viewpoint thumbnails.
One compact editor for selection and changes, with only a small cue visible during a building drag.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Day and night share the same roles and geometry. Night also replaces the foreground on the orange action through `--on-accent`.

rules.name: The Single Editor Rule
rules.body: Selection and building changes share one compact panel. A selection shows the building name, height, drag hint, Hide, and More. Undo stays available whenever history exists, without a timed toast. After deselection, the same panel shows the changed-building count. Without a selection or remaining building changes, available history keeps "No building changes" and Undo visible. With no selection, changes, or history, the editor is absent.

rules.name: The Clear Drag Rule
rules.body: Once the pointer travels beyond the drag threshold (5px) on a selected building, the panel and map controls disappear. The cue names the building and offers Escape to cancel. A completed move returns to the selected editor with Undo. Escape, pointer cancellation, lost capture, or window blur restore the starting position without adding a history step. A drag belongs to its initiating pointer. Editing and camera shortcuts are suppressed during the drag.

dos: Do bind controls to the shared day and night variables.
Do retain keyboard focus, visible action labels, and named camera groups.
Do measure the editor before placing phone navigation above it.
Do keep Undo in the editor whenever history is available.
Do clear map chrome while a selected building is being dragged.
donts: Don't use camera home to restore building edits.
Don't turn the contextual controls into a permanent sidebar or bottom tray.
Don't split selection, change status, and Undo across separate panels.
Don't put global building-reset actions inside a selected-building menu.
Don't treat the frontmatter palette as the renderer's terrain, sky, or building palette.
